title: Introduction to end-to-end analytics using Microsoft Fabric - Training
summary: Discover how Microsoft Fabric can meet your enterprise's analytics needs in one platform. Discover the capabilities Fabric has to offer, understand how it works, and identify how you can use Fabric for your analytics needs.

title: Orchestrate Processes and Data Movement with Microsoft Fabric - Training
summary: Use Data Factory pipelines in Microsoft Fabric

title: Ingest Data with Dataflows in Microsoft Fabric - Training
summary: Data ingestion is crucial in analytics. Microsoft Fabric's Data Factory offers Dataflows for visually creating multi-step data ingestion and transformation using Power Query Online.

title: Work with Delta Lake Tables in Microsoft Fabric - Training
summary: Tables in a Microsoft Fabric lakehouse are based on the Delta Lake technology commonly used in Apache Spark. By using the enhanced capabilities of delta tables, you can create advanced analytics solutions.

title: Use Apache Spark in Microsoft Fabric - Training
summary: Apache Spark is a core technology for large-scale data analytics. Microsoft Fabric provides support for Spark clusters, enabling you to analyze and process data at scale.

title: Get started with lakehouses in Microsoft Fabric - Training
summary: Lakehouses in Microsoft Fabric combine data lake flexibility with data warehouse analytics. Learn how to create, load, and query a lakehouse on a single platform.

title: Get Started with Data Warehouses in Microsoft Fabric - Training
summary: Understand the key components and design considerations for implementation of data warehouses in Microsoft Fabric.

title: Query a data warehouse in Microsoft Fabric - Training
summary: Learn to query a Microsoft Fabric data warehouse using the SQL query editor, visual query editor, and SQL Server Management Studio.

title: Monitor a Microsoft Fabric Data Warehouse - Training
summary: A data warehouse is a vital component of an enterprise analytics solution. It's important to learn how to monitor a data warehouse so you can better understand the activity that occurs in it.

title: Load data into a Microsoft Fabric data warehouse - Training
summary: Learn how to load data into a Microsoft Fabric warehouse using data pipelines, T-SQL, and Dataflow Gen2.

title: Organize a Fabric Lakehouse Using Medallion Architecture Design - Training
summary: Explore the potential of the medallion architecture design in Microsoft Fabric. Organize and transform your data across Bronze, Silver, and Gold layers of a lakehouse for optimized analytics.

title: Work with real-time data in an Eventhouse in Microsoft Fabric - Training
summary: Microsoft Fabric provides a scalable and flexible store for real-time data.

title: Use Eventstream in Microsoft Fabric - Training
summary: Eventstream in Real-Time Intelligence (RTI) enables you to ingest, transform, and route real-time data.

title: Get started with Real-Time Intelligence in Microsoft Fabric - Training
summary: Real-Time Intelligence in Microsoft Fabric has capabilities that help you ingest, process, store, visualize, and act on data in motion to gain immediate insights from events as they happen.

title: Train and track machine learning models with MLflow in Microsoft Fabric - Training
summary: Learn how to train machine learning models in notebooks and track your work with MLflow experiments in Microsoft Fabric.

title: Preprocess data with Data Wrangler in Microsoft Fabric - Training
summary: Explore the process of preparing data for machine learning models using the Data Wrangler tool in Microsoft Fabric notebooks.

title: Get started with data science in Microsoft Fabric - Training
summary: Get started with data science in Microsoft Fabric by learning how to train a model in a notebook, and track your metrics with MLflow and experiments.

title: Generate batch predictions using a deployed model in Microsoft Fabric - Training
summary: Learn how to use a trained machine learning model to generate batch predictions in Microsoft Fabric.

title: Get started with SQL Database in Microsoft Fabric - Training
summary: Learn how SQL Database in Microsoft Fabric works, the key concepts, and practical examples to help users SQL Database effectively as part of their analytics solutions.

title: Get started with GraphQL in Microsoft Fabric - Training
summary: Learn how GraphQL in Microsoft Fabric works, the key concepts, and practical examples to help users integrate their applications with GraphQL effectively as part of their solutions.

title: Administer a Microsoft Fabric Environment - Training
summary: Learn how to configure and manage a Microsoft Fabric environment, including tenant settings, domain setup, admin delegation, user licensing, and platform monitoring.

title: Secure Data Access in Microsoft Fabric - Training
summary: Implement workspace roles, item permissions, and OneLake security roles to control data access in Microsoft Fabric.

title: Secure a Microsoft Fabric data warehouse - Training
summary: Learn the key concepts and strategies for protecting sensitive data in Microsoft Fabric data warehouses.

title: Monitor Activities in Microsoft Fabric - Training
summary: Learn how to use the monitoring hub in Microsoft Fabric to track activity status, investigate failures, and view historical run data. Explore how Activator responds to Fabric job events with automated alerts and actions.

title: Govern Analytics Data in Microsoft Fabric - Training
summary: Implement Fabric-native governance practices including data classification, sensitivity labels, endorsement, and documentation to ensure data assets are trustworthy and governed for both human and AI consumption.

title: Manage the Semantic Model Development Lifecycle - Training
summary: Manage semantic models through their full development lifecycle. Create reusable assets, version-control with Git, inspect and validate with the XMLA endpoint and SemPy, deploy through pipelines, and maintain with monitoring and impact analysis.

title: Design Semantic Models for Scale in Microsoft Fabric - Training
summary: Design semantic models for scale in Microsoft Fabric. Choose storage modes, design star schema relationships, create scalable calculation patterns, and configure settings for large datasets and concurrent consumption.

title: Enforce Power BI model security - Training
summary: Restrict access to Power BI model data by implementing row-level security (RLS) and object-level security (OLS) to protect sensitive information.

title: Implement Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD) in Microsoft Fabric - Training
summary: Learn the key concepts and strategies for implementing continuous integration and continuous deployment (CI/CD) in Microsoft Fabric.
